PC:castlevania-belmonts-curse.d: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is a 2026 action role-playing game developed by Evil Empire, with advice from Motion Twin, and published by Konami. It is the 26th main entry of the Castlevania franchise, celebrating its 40th anniversary. Taking place in 1499, over two decades after the events of Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse (1989) and Castlevania: Curse of Darkness (2005), the story follows Rose Belmont, daughter of vampire hunter Trevor Belmont and his wife Sypha Belnades, who ventures into Dracula's castle as it manifests directly in the heart of Paris. The game returns to the exploration-based design of previous series entries such as Castlevania: Symphony of the Night (1997).
